title: Tangerine puffer pressed into fresh powder

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The cropped puffer lies spread out on a ridge of fresh powder snow at blue hour, seen from directly above, arms flung wide as if its wearer had just dropped back into the snow and stepped away, the powder pressed softly around its shape. Fine snow crystals rest on the glossy tangerine nylon, which glows against the blue-shadowed snow, and the last pink light touches the snow crust at one edge of the frame. Straight down from above, the jacket filling the centre.
